Guidance for Claude Code (claude.ai/code): Native SwiftUI Hotlympics iOS app (ratings, leaderboards, uploads, profiles).

open ios-app.xcodeproj
xcodebuild -project ios-app.xcodeproj -scheme ios-app -destination 'platform=iOS Simulator,name=iPhone 16 Pro' build
xcodebuild test -project ios-app.xcodeproj -scheme ios-app -destination 'platform=iOS Simulator,name=iPhone 16 Pro'
xcodebuild clean -project ios-app.xcodeproj

Bundle ID: hotlympics.ios-app; preferred simulator: iPhone 16 Pro. Dependencies: Firebase Auth, Firebase Storage, Google Sign-In via Swift Package Manager. After making changes, build the project and fix any warnings or errors. Test on iPhone 16 Pro simulator.

Entry: `App/ios_appApp.swift` configures Firebase/Google Sign-In URL schemes. Tabs: Rating and Leaderboard unrestricted; Upload, My Photos, Profile require authentication and complete profile.

Services: `auth/FirebaseAuthService` handles Google OAuth, session/tokens, backend sync, gender/DOB, ToS, profile completion. `data/ImageQueueService` handles 10-image active/buffer blocks, prefetch, gender filtering, auth resets. `api/RatingService` submits ratings. `data/ImagePreloader` shared 50-image NSCache; clears on memory pressure. `api/UploadService` requests signed URLs, uploads compressed images to Firebase Storage with URLSession progress, confirms backend. `data/UserService` caches photos/pool 5 minutes, preloads, refreshes after changes, optimistically deletes. UI/ViewModels: rating swipe/dual-image cards; upload picker/camera/progress/400x400 cropper; photos grid/pool (max 2); email/password and Google auth, sequential profile setup; `shared/CachedAsyncImageView`; `MyPhotosViewModel` manages grid/pool/deletion/validation; `UploadViewModel` handles processing, compression, progress, retries.

Flows: Rating fetches blocks, submits, advances buffer; auth changes
